teamNotes: ARC Prize 2025: the gold medal and 3rd place belong to the whole team entry. His profile writeup names the team MindsAI & Tufa Labs and lists five members, and the five accounts on the competitions row are consistent with those five people, but Kaggle's list does not label which handle is which person, so the handle-to-name pairing is an inference and no individual credit is claimed beyond what the profile itself says.
Stanford RNA 3D Folding Part 2: the gold medal is a two-account team result shared with bradleyshervheim.

ARC Prize 2026: Kaggle lists ARC-AGI-3 and ARC-AGI-2 among his two active competitions. The roster and standing observations already in people.json (ARC-3 team Abstraction Lab & MindsAI, then ARC-2 teams Jack Cole and ARC Mutants) come from the public ARC board feed, were not re-read from Kaggle here, and are provisional until the private leaderboards settle at the close.
A team medal appears on the profile of every account on that entry. It is never written up as Jack alone.
